fig9.note: winding-as-dominant-mechanism claim retired after round-3 control test; see RESULTS F9

extensions.orientation_note: step density along wire scales as |cos(chi)|, chi = azimuth between wire and miscut gradient; wires along step edges (chi=90deg) see no steps

summary.verdict: 4-band LK across plausible rectangles+fields gives gx in [0.4,1.07]; measured 1.9-2.3 NOT reproduced -> discrepancy attributed to tri-gate electrostatics, strain, and 6-band/cubic terms; BRACKETED by running all platform numbers with both LK and empirical tensors (fig10/fig11)

secD._paired: same terrace seeds for all w

secE._paired: same terrace seeds for all fsup

secF._note: each bunch = one 1.7pi (== -0.3pi) jump; compare secB theta0.1deg

orbital.model: 2D strip + Peierls phases of B_perp on x-hoppings (Landau gauge, y from centre); E_Z from full |B|, g=2.2; orbital effect isolated as with-vs-without Peierls at fixed E_Z

design_point.note: Preferred tilted SiB_meas operating point: B=0.333 T, Delta_ind=11.3 ueV (key_numbers fig8 center_SiB_measured_args), tilt theta=38.57 deg (fig11 LK-tensor optimum). Suppression = 1 - gap(orbital)/gap(no orbital) at fixed E_Z from |B|.

powerlaw.note: no 10% crossing inside the sampled 7.5-40 nm range; W10pct_nm is a power-law extrapolation far outside it (single-subband model)

gap_closure.note: (gx110 - gx100)/(g_meas - gx100), production point and bracket maxima

secY_wafer_yields._yield_def: yield = frac(E2 >= 4.0 ueV) (single-0.85pi-step ceiling = 4.03 ueV at this operating point); also frac(E2 >= 1 ueV)
secY_wafer_yields._sampling: theta_m stratified U[0.2*spec, spec] x 4, kgam=4, chi = wire vs step-edge angle, 10 seeds/cell, 40 realizations per (spec, chi)

secV_valley_x_ramp._rule: mu(lam) = max(lam-40, mu_crit+20-lam), mu_crit = 71.0 ueV; lower band at mu_eff=-40 for lam>=75; at lam=40 mu=51 keeps the upper band trivial (its ~17 ueV gap caps clean E2)
secV_valley_x_ramp._grid: N=1000, dx=2.5 nm, single 0.85pi step at L/2, tanh ramp width w

calibration.A_def: mean |e*dphi(centroid)| over 3 interface sites x both signs
calibration.proxy: point trap smeared over 2*lc = 30 nm along wire (2D line charge), SCF-screened (toy density, canonical)
